purpose: Measured Godot slicing plan for the unselected A/B Imperial environment-prop cutout sheets.

a.direction: restrained court-tech in blue-black lacquer, aged gold, and limited burgundy

b.direction: practical Imperial industrial construction in iron, ivory, brass, and limited oxblood

godotHandoff.approvalGate: Do not import, atlas, manifest, or place either choice until the developer selects a branch.
godotHandoff.slicing: After approval, create AtlasTexture regions from suggestedCrop; retain transparent padding and derive placement pivots per scene role.
godotHandoff.console: Use only as non-interactive scene dressing unless a later gameplay specification assigns state.
godotHandoff.machineryColumn: Suitable for midground wall dressing or restrained parallax; keep the base aligned to local architecture.
godotHandoff.architecturalFragment: Use as a low occluder or damaged wall-base insert without implying loot or an interactable break state.
godotHandoff.cablePipeCluster: Place along an upper or side edge and rotate only in 90-degree increments if the lighting direction remains plausible.
godotHandoff.stateOwnership: All interaction, highlight, damage, selection, and gameplay state remain runtime-owned and absent from these proposed textures.
